notes.title: "Goblin VS Princess" joins the June 9 Next Fest with a free demo!
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello Steam friends![/b][/p][p]I’m Senluo, the producer of [i]Goblin & Princess[/i], and I’m thrilled to share that our game [b]demo[/b] is now available during the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]![/p][p]To celebrate, we’re hosting a [b]giveaway with awesome prizes[/b]—just head over to the [b]Keylol Forum[/b], search for our game, and [b]add it to your wishlist[/b] to enter![/p][p]*(First-time jitters—forgive my rambling! Oh, and here’s our official QQ group for updates: 982718235.)*[/p][p]To all our [b]beloved players[/b]: Your feedback is [b]golden[/b]. We’re all ears, so don’t hold back![/p][p]Finally, [b]give the demo a try[/b], wishlist if you like it, and most importantly—[b]have fun![/b][/p]
